'''Kilon''' was a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] who lived in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], working for the [[organization]] of the [[Oblee]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Nirama]]. Kilon eventually left Nirama's organization and by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] had became a member of the [[Believers]], a [[Sith cult/Legends|Sith cult]] that was active in the Cularin [[Star system/Legends|system]].

{{RPG|''[[Belted In: Recursion|Recursion]]''}}
Kilon was among a team of Believers that were dispatched to the [[Cularin asteroid belt]] by [[Len Markus]], to prevent the [[Heroes of Cularin]] from destroying three [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] shards that were funneling power to the [[Darkstaff]], [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifact]] that was possessed by Markus.
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The composition of the group of Believers that appear in ''[[Belted In: Recursion|Recursion]]'' varies depending upon the [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game|role-playing]] tier of the player characters, and Kilon only appears if the players are in the upper tier.
